title: Editor validation: inline errors, numeric input, type lock, emoji limit
findings_note: MainScreen.kt:523-790 (text fields for date/hour/minute; Save no-ops at :650,:656,:760,:764)
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the date picker and time picker (S40), editing the tracker colour (the field exists in the model but is not editable, and stays that way for the MVP), and moving strings to resources (S18).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
- An invalid value makes Save silently do nothing (`return@Button`), with no message.
- Number fields use the default text keyboard and `toDoubleOrNull()`, so `2,5` is rejected in comma-decimal locales and `Infinity` is accepted (S33 fixes the rules; this slice uses them).
- COUNT entries with a blank value silently become 1.0.
- Changing a tracker's type after logging (for example COUNT to YES_NO) silently reinterprets its history.
- A second YES_NO entry on a date that already has one is accepted. The owner decided YES_NO counts once per day.
- The emoji field takes any text.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- New `app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/EditorValidation.kt`
- New `app/src/test/java/com/squalor/consecutor/EditorValidationTest.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/ui/TrackerEditorDialog.kt` and `ui/EntryEditorDialog.kt` (or `MainScreen.kt` if S32 has not landed)

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
JVM, in `EditorValidationTest`:
- `name is required, trimmed, and at most 60 characters`
- `description is at most 280 characters and unit at most 20`
- `emoji must be a single character` (`"😀"` is valid, `"ab"` is not; do not test joined sequences, because the JVM and Android break them differently)
- `target must be a positive number when enabled and is ignored when disabled or for measure`
- `count entry value is required and must be positive`
- `measure entry value is required and may be negative or zero`
- `entry value rejects NaN, Infinity and values above the maximum`
- `entry date after today is rejected`
- `yes_no entry on a date that already has another entry is rejected, and editing the same entry is allowed`

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. `EditorValidation.kt` (no Android imports) defines:
   - `enum class FormError { REQUIRED, TOO_LONG, NOT_A_NUMBER, MUST_BE_POSITIVE, FUTURE_DATE, INVALID_DATE, ONE_CHARACTER_ONLY, ALREADY_LOGGED }`
   - `enum class TrackerField { NAME, EMOJI, DESCRIPTION, UNIT, TARGET }` and `enum class EntryField { DATE, VALUE }`
   - `fun validateTrackerForm(name, emoji, description, unit, type, targetEnabled, targetText, locale): Map<TrackerField, FormError>`
   - `fun validateEntryForm(type, date: LocalDate?, valueText, today, otherYesNoDates: Set<LocalDate>, locale): Map<EntryField, FormError>`
   Use `NumberRules.parseDecimal` (S33) for numbers. A blank number is `REQUIRED`, an unparseable or out-of-range one is `NOT_A_NUMBER`, and zero or negative where positive is needed is `MUST_BE_POSITIVE`. Count the emoji with `java.text.BreakIterator.getCharacterInstance()`.
2. Dialogs: keep a `showErrors` flag that turns on after the first Save press. Save stays enabled. When pressed it runs the validator, and if there are errors it sets `showErrors = true` and does not save. Each field shows `isError = true` and `supportingText` from a `when` over `FormError` (English text for now; S18 moves it to resources). After the first attempt, errors update as the user types.
3. Number fields use `KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = KeyboardType.Decimal)`. Parse with `NumberRules.parseDecimal` instead of `toDoubleOrNull`. The COUNT entry value field is prefilled with `1` for a new entry.
4. The entry dialog keeps the existing `YYYY-MM-DD` text field until S40 replaces it. A value that does not parse as a date gives `INVALID_DATE` ("Use the format YYYY-MM-DD").
5. Pass the entry dialog the set of other active entry dates for YES_NO (from `detail.entries`, excluding the entry being edited). `ALREADY_LOGGED` shows "Already logged on this date."
6. Type lock: when editing a tracker that has at least one active entry (`detail.entries.isNotEmpty()`), disable the type chips and show the helper text "Type can't change after logging."
7. Keep the dialog state `rememberSaveable` where S10 made it so. Do not undo that.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest` passes.
- Manual: Save with a blank name shows an error and does not close. A target of `0` or `abc` shows an error. In a German locale `2,5` is accepted for a MEASURE value. A COUNT entry of `0` is rejected. A second YES_NO entry on the same date is rejected. The type chips are disabled for a tracker that has entries. An emoji field with `ab` is rejected.
